iteration: v123 — PERF.md uses NO prefetcher; 3-sub-device approach blocked
key_finding_1: TT's simple_text_demo.py hard-codes use_prefetcher=False. ALL PERF.md numbers are measured WITHOUT the DRAM prefetcher. The prefetcher is aspirational code, not yet integrated into benchmarked paths.
key_finding_2: tt-metal sub_device API requires programs on a single sub-device. 3-sub-device layout (sender/receiver/compute) fails with: TT_FATAL: Programs must be executed on a single sub-device

qwen3_8B.note: Qwen3-8B has 36 layers vs Llama-3.1-8B 32 layers. Architecture differences (GQA config) account for remaining 6% gap.

qwen3_1_7B.note: Larger gap likely from: Llama-3.2-1B has more kernel tuning, different GQA config (32/8 vs 16/8)

prefetcher_attempts.2_sub_device: L1 CB clashes with RMSNorm on receiver/worker cores at all ring sizes (170KB-816KB)
prefetcher_attempts.3_sub_device: tt-metal API limitation: programs must run on single sub-device. Can't partition receiver and compute cores.
prefetcher_attempts.conclusion: DRAM prefetcher integration requires upstream tt-metal changes to support multi-sub-device program execution OR a fundamentally different L1 partitioning approach. Not achievable from the plugin side.
